purpose.summary: This is a large dispatch/router program for an ACUCOBOL-GT GUI lookup (zoom) widget used in a business application. It receives a file/entity name via the LINKAGE SECTION and, based on that name, calls one of many PREPARA-* paragraphs to configure and launch the XZOOM lookup window for various business entities (clients, suppliers, articles, orders, invoices, warehouses, agents, etc.). It appears to be part of an Italian ERP or order-management system.
